name: Istorija odnogo iz mnogih
source:
Like many of the pioneers, this Semyon has been through a lot... Through madness... Through decay... But everything ends eventually.

The mod tells the story of one of the many Semyons stuck in the pioneer camp.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2031448903]Steam[/url]]
translation:
像许多先驱者一样，这个谢苗经历了很多……经历了疯狂……经历了腐朽……但一切最终都会结束。

该模组讲述了被困在先锋营地的众多Semyons之一的故事。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2031448903]Steam[/url]]
